summary: NexGen Energy Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on August 28, 2026, announcing its 2026 Investor Day to be held on September 1, 2026. The pre-recorded virtual event will feature presentations from senior leadership on the construction of its 100% owned Rook I Project, a uranium mine in Saskatchewan. No special-situation transactional event occurred; it is an ordinary investor communications and meeting notice. No deal terms, pricing, M&A activity, or board actions are involved. This is routine disclosure for a foreign private issuer, not a special situation.
